newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia allocates 62,000 bpd of Minas in June.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia allocates 62,000 bpd of Minas in June.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina has allocated 62,000 barrels per day (bpd) of Minas export crude for June lifting, down from 73,000 bpd in May, traders said on Friday.
Despite the cut, traders said the allocation was higher than had been expected.
Some had estimated the Minas allocation would be as low as 20,000-30,000 bpd.
Traders said the lower allocation was the result of export Minas being diverted to feed a new 60,000-bpd crude distillation unit at the Balikpapan refinery.
The CDU is due to start up in June or early July, Samto Utomo, Pertamina's junior processing director, told Reuters in Jakarta earlier.
Worries about a lower Minas allocation had forced the market premium for the crude to ICP +30 cents in recent days from ICP +15 cents.
